nodes.code:
import json

item_count = params["item_count"] or 0
status_counts = params["status_counts"] or {}
priority_counts = params["priority_counts"] or {}
assignee_counts = params["assignee_counts"] or {}
overdue_items = params["overdue_items"] or []
overdue_count = params["overdue_count"] or 0

overdue_brief = [
    {
        "title": it.get("title"),
        "priority": it.get("priority"),
        "dueDate": it.get("dueDate"),
        "assigneeIds": it.get("assigneeIds"),
    }
    for it in overdue_items
]

data = {
    "total_items": item_count,
    "status_counts": status_counts,
    "priority_counts": priority_counts,
    "assignee_counts": assignee_counts,
    "overdue_count": overdue_count,
    "overdue_items": overdue_brief,
}

summary_text = api.ai.generate(
    prompt=(
        "You are writing a short section of a weekly operations report for a business owner. "
        "Using ONLY the JSON data provided (WorkQ item counts by status, priority, assignee, and "
        "overdue items), identify the main bottlenecks: where work is piling up, which statuses or "
        "priorities dominate, whether any assignee is overloaded, and how serious the overdue backlog "
        "is. Write 3-5 concise plain-English sentences or a short bulleted list suitable for direct "
        "inclusion in an HTML report. Do not invent data not present in the input, and do not restate "
        "raw numbers mechanically \u2014 interpret them."
    ),
    input=json.dumps(data),
) or ""

outputs.description: A concise AI-written summary of the main bottlenecks, based only on the provided counts and overdue data.
outputs.name: summary_text

nodes.summary: Uses AI to write a short plain-English summary of where WorkQ work is piling up, based on the status, priority, assignee and overdue counts for the week.
nodes.title: Ask AI to summarize the main bottlenecks

import html report_date = params["report_date"] or "" report_date = str(report_date) data_notes = params["data_notes"] or "" item_count = params["item_count"] or 0 status_counts = params["status_counts"] or {} priority_counts = params["priority_counts"] or {} assignee_counts = params["assignee_counts"] or {} overdue_items = params["overdue_items"] or [] overdue_count = params["overdue_count"] or 0 summary_text = params["summary_text"] or "" artifact_visibility = params["artifact_visibility"] or "private" notify_user_id = params["notify_user_id"] or "" title = f"WorkQ Bottleneck Report — {report_date}" def _rows(d): if not d: return "None" return "".join(f"{html.escape(str(k))}{html.escape(str(v))}" for k, v in d.items()) def _overdue_rows(items): if not items: return "None" rows = [] for it in items: rows.append( "{}{}{}{}".format( html.escape(str(it.get("title", ""))), html.escape(str(it.get("status", ""))), html.escape(str(it.get("priority", ""))), html.escape(str(it.get("dueDate", "") or "")), ) ) return "".join(rows) html_content = f""" {html.escape(title)}

{html.escape(title)}

Total WorkQ items: {item_count}  |  Overdue: {overdue_count}

Bottleneck Summary

{html.escape(summary_text)}

Counts by Status

{_rows(status_counts)}
StatusCount

Counts by Priority

{_rows(priority_counts)}
PriorityCount

Counts by Assignee

{_rows(assignee_counts)}
AssigneeCount

Overdue Items

{_overdue_rows(overdue_items)}
TitleStatusPriorityDue Date

{html.escape(data_notes)}

""" file_name = f"workq_bottleneck_report_{report_date}.html" result = api.artifacts.put( title=title, content=html_content, file_name=file_name, description=f"Weekly WorkQ bottleneck report for {report_date}.", kind="document", visibility=artifact_visibility, mime_type="text/html", tags=["workq", "weekly-report"], ) artifact_id = result.get("artifact_id") or "" artifact_url = result.get("url") or "" api.notify.send( title=title, body=f"This week's WorkQ bottleneck report is ready. {overdue_count} item(s) are overdue.\n\n{artifact_url}", user_ids=[notify_user_id] if notify_user_id else None, )
